correctness.rationale: For any full clock target y, each predecessor value for target 2 and 1 is forced (old 1 and 0); its excited sites are therefore precisely y=2. A target-0 vertex independently chooses old2 or old0, old0 valid iff its count of y=2 neighbors is below theta. This proves the exact inverse power of two including external states. For any primitive-three orbit, every vertex is either permanently 0 or cycles all three colors. Active successor contacts require at least r|A| distinct phase-crossing edges, while e(G[A])<=r|A| by 2r-regularity. Equality forces no active-silent boundary and connectedness makes all vertices active; every vertex has r in each opposite phase. Hence each zero vertex has exactly r preceding color-2 neighbors, inverse exponent zero and unique previous clock phase. Reversing the last entrance edge excludes all outside transients. Independently exhausted 3^6 C6² configurations: six critical full clocks, each indegree one; θ=1 source witness in RESULT demonstrates sharp change. Finite enumeration supports, not proves, the all-graph statement.
